thread:
Harper: Thanks for joining today's all-hands — recording + deck: https://redwood.example/ah/dec-2026-recording and https://redwood.example/ah/dec-2026-slides. Leaving a compact Q&A + action list.

Jun: Quick clarifying note: Dedicated GA bumped to 2027-01-12 to allow extra canary cycles. Internal canaries start 2026-12-20.

Asha: Product recap: priorities are Dedicated GA, Optimize cost-tools beta (cost profiler + runtime heuristics), and Private pilot expansion (data residency + audit-mode). Owners: Jun/runtime, Leo/infra, Mira/customer. I'll coordinate product follow-ups.

Leo: Infra update: provisioning plan for canaries + new queue-latency SLO dashboards. Ticket INF-1124 created: https://go.redwood/tickets/INF-1124. Runbook stub: https://runbooks.redwood.example/dedicated-ga-runbook.

Mira: Customer ops will draft migration SDK changelog and a one-page "what to expect" for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated. Need supported tokenizer/adapter matrix from runtime.

ops-bot: Feature-flag status: "dedicated-int8" = off in prod. Toggle requires 2 approvers and an updated runbook. See process: https://go.redwood/ff-proc.

Harper: Security/Legal highlighted an extra item: data residency add-on for EU customers. We need clear guidance and a short FAQ. Legal to sign off on copy.

Jun: Runtime notes: int8 path is feature-flagged; kernel autoprobing PR in review. I'll create a compatibility matrix and known-caveats doc in the repo. Posting RFC link by Mon.

Asha: Action items (owners + targets):
- Jun: RFC + compatibility matrix + PR by Mon (2411080000)
- Leo: infra dashboards + capacity plan by Wed (2411160000)
- Mira: SDK changelog + migration one-pager by Thu (2411240000)
- Legal: data residency FAQ draft by Fri (2411320000)
Please add Asana tasks and paste links in this thread.

Harper: Also add a 1-line "what could break" and rollback plan to each PR. Use #release-war-room for coordination and schedule office hours the week of canaries.

Mira: I'll schedule two office-hours slots (one APAC-friendly) and post sign-up. Also will include a checklist for customer-side smoke tests.

Jun: Volunteers for perf + long-context runs pls sign up. Perf helper snippet below:
```
./tools/loadgen --profile=dedicated-ga-longctx --rps=600 --duration=30m --seed=2026
```

Leo: Infra will share loadgen scripts + an example dashboard link when provisioned. Also adding a short CI speed target: reduce end-to-end canary validation from 45m -> 20m where possible.

SRE-bot: Scheduled job: perf-report-gen -> next run 2026-12-01T03:00Z. Alert: queue-latency threshold currently set at 120ms p95.

finance-bot: Finance note: pricing draft for Dedicated GA includes reserved capacity + burst metering. Finance to publish a migration pricing blurb next week. contact: finance@redwood.example

Asha: Customer question from live Q: Will on-prem Private support HSM/KMS integration at GA? Short answer: KMS yes; HSM planned post-GA. Security to confirm key import flow.

Jun: For rollback we'll pin runtime image + disable int8 flag on canaries. Example commands for canary rollback:
```
# rollback canary
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-canary runtime-image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.12.1
./tools/ff toggle dedicated-int8 off --env=prod --approvers=2
```

Mira: Draft comms will include migration SDK changelog, FAQ, and a short upgrade checklist for customers. Will post to #marketing-review and link back.

Harper: Please link Asana tasks here once created. I'll run a 20-min follow-up sync tomorrow to check progress and confirm office hours. If anything blocks, DM me directly.

Jun: posting RFC + PR links here shortly.

Leo: creating INF-1124 sub-tasks and will paste links.

Mira: sign-up for office hours posted: https://redwood.example/ah/office-hours-signup.

Harper: closing thread for now; will reopen if critical blockers show before the sync. Thanks all :raised_hands:
